title: RunArtifact
description: One file deliverable produced by a run — the item shape of the artifact-listing API (GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/artifacts; download at GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id}). SEMANTICS (normative): an artifact is a POINTER into the workspace's content tree recorded at registration time, not an immutable snapshot — download serves the file's CURRENT bytes; sha256/size_bytes are provenance metadata from registration, and a later run that modifies the same file registers its own row. A listed artifact whose underlying file has since been removed downloads as 410 {"detail":{"code":"artifact_gone"}}. SECURITY: artifact_id is an opaque server-generated id — no API route ever accepts a file path from a client, and no artifact carries a URL, host, or token; clients COMPOSE the download URL from the contract route and send the Bearer header (web clients via fetch()+blob — a token MUST NEVER appear in a query string). Downloads are always Content-Disposition: attachment with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; clients MUST NOT render artifact bytes inline in a browser origin (agent output over untrusted inputs). rel_path is display/informational only and MUST NOT be used to construct any request. Clients MUST ignore unknown fields (additive evolution).

artifact_id.description: Opaque server-generated id (UUID) — the only key a client sends back, as the download route's path segment.

run_id.description: The run that registered this artifact.

name.description: Display filename, e.g. 'account-dossier-acme-2026-08-09.docx'. Also the attachment filename on download.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the workspace content tree, informational only (e.g. 'accounts/acme/account-dossier-acme-2026-08-09.docx'). NEVER sent back to the server.

media_type.description: Server-assigned from an extension allowlist; 'application/octet-stream' for anything unrecognised. Never client-supplied.

sha256.description: Content hash at registration time (provenance; not verified at download — see pointer semantics above).

node_id.description: Producing graph node (joins onto PackDescriptor.nodes[].id), when attributable.
